<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A JSON API with the contract first: api/openapi.yaml written from the model, the server generated by ogen and mounted at /api/v1, and each module's HTTP part, which translates between the contract and its use cases. Errors are Problem Details: a request that does not match the contract, an Accept without JSON, a body that is not JSON or is too large, and the module's refusals. With testcontainers, the operations get tests through the whole contract.

```esquadro
blueprint rest
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/), [store](../store/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [i18n](../i18n/), [rate_limit](../rate_limit/), [security_headers](../security_headers/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | `""` | Title of the API in the contract; the app's name when empty. |
| `max_body_kb` | int | `1024` | Largest request body, in KB; 0 turns the limit off. &lt;APP>_MAX_BODY_KB overrides it. |

```esquadro
blueprint rest {
  title ""
}
```

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `rest.tags` | Tags of your own operations in api/openapi.yaml, indented by two. |
| `rest.paths` | Paths of your own operations, indented by two. |
| `rest.schemas` | Schemas of your own operations, indented by four. |

## Hooks

- `post-gen` ogen, writes `internal/apigen/**`

## Go modules

- `github.com/ogen-go/ogen` v1.24.0
